Marie (CS): Quick weekly health check — focusing p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Dropping the highlights below, please chime in with any regressions or customer impacts.
Devon (Acct): Thanks — can you call out any renewal risk flags?
Marie (CS): Early flags: usage -12% MoM for a subset of legacy routes, spend -9%. No escalations yet but watch HelixApps and Harbor. Renewal risk: medium for two mid-market accounts (Greenfield, NeoEdge) — both negotiating seat counts.
telemetry-bot: Automated snapshot (7d):
```
Route                        | Model        | Mode       | p95   | p99   | errors
/chat/completions (helix)    | gptx-8k-open | streaming  | 180ms | 420ms | 0.8% (503s)
/chat/completions (helix)    | gptx-8k-open | non-stream | 240ms | 860ms | 0.8% (503s)
/rerank                       | rank-mini    | streaming  | 95ms  | 210ms | 0.15%
/embeddings                   | embed-lite   | non-stream | 60ms  | 120ms | 0.03%
```
Owen (PM): HelixApps numbers look concerning — p99 non-stream jumped a lot. Is that correlated with any deploy?
Alan (SRE): I saw a canary deploy last Tue 13:12 UTC to the dedicated pool for helix-worker, CPU spiked on two hosts during burst windows. Possible KV cache thrash. Investigating.
Sam (Solutions): Greenfield onboarding at 65% (docs + evals done), they hit higher p99 on non-streaming during long-context tests. Suggested temporary routing to streaming variant to keep latency SLOs for their demo.
Devon (Acct): Noted — I'll propose streaming-route fallback in the renewal playbook. Any quick mitigation?
Alan (SRE): Short term: pin helix-worker to previous image for dedicated pool (roll back canary). Also increasing prefetch cache TTL for KV on those hosts. Will open infra ticket.
telemetry-bot: New incident logged: INF-7212 (investigating helix dedicated pool CPU + 503s).
Marie (CS): Action items: 1) Alan -> INF-7212, include p95/p99 traces and canary diff. 2) Sam -> propose streaming fallback config + customer-facing note. 3) Devon -> update renewal playbook with fallback and cost impact. 4) Owen -> track Greenfield demo readiness.
Alan (SRE): On it; I can rollback now, ETA 25m.
Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the fallback config and a short howto for CS.
Devon (Acct): I'll flag both Greenfield and NeoEdge in CRM as "watch: latency".
Marie (CS): Thanks all. If rollback works and INF-7212 confirms canary cause, re-check p99 in 24h and update thread. :thumbsup:
Owen (PM): FYI — monitor spend signal after fallback; streaming may increase tokens but will lower error/retry cost.
Marie (CS): Closing note: no urgent renewals due this week, but follow-up required before next contract review.
